description: This file defines a feature for listing comments for an article identified by a slug within the Conduit project, including a query object and its handler that interacts with the database context to retrieve comments and handle errors if the article is not found.

classes.name: List
classes.description: Contains the query object and handler for listing comments associated with an article identified by a slug.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the query to retrieve comments for the specified article slug; fetches article with comments and author, throws exception if not found, otherwise returns comments envelope.
